_generated_by: per-country feature review 2026-08-17, data/curation/research/*_review.json, measured against data/curation/wire_snapshot/ (5,472 rows: 2,177 beaches, 3,295 mountains, 43 countries)

_how_to_read.rank: 1 is the rule to ship first: highest wrong-entry removal for the lowest good-entry loss. Rules that lose nothing rank above rules that lose something, and within each group by volume.
_how_to_read.action: drop = delete the row. merge = collapse into a surviving row and inherit its best name and image. reassign = move to another country. renormalise / rename_or_drop / strip_then_dedupe = repair the string first, delete only if nothing survives. cap_tier2 / cap_tier3 / demote_band = a TIER gate, the row stays in the file. quarantine_image = drop the photo, keep the row. flag_for_p31 = select rows for the type test, never delete. resolve_to_highest_peak = replace a range with its summit. fold_into_parent = replace a sub-top with its parent, or promote the parent if it is absent. reroute = move to another kind.
_how_to_read.measurement: rows_removed_total is a real count over the wire snapshot, not an estimate. of_which_reviewers_had_flagged_as_wrong is how many of those rows appear in the 648 wrong entries the 11 reviewers wrote up. collateral is the remainder, every row of which was read for rules under 120 hits.
_how_to_read.good_entries_wrongly_removed: the shippability test. A rule that also deletes Zandvoort aan Zee is not shippable. Every rule here was run against a 480-name regression corpus built from top_picks_seed.json plus the top picks the reviewers endorsed, and tightened until it stopped hitting it.

what_the_other_348_need: OSM tags: 27 hospitality rows whose names are clean (Albania's King Beach, Coco Beach, Lori Beach are natural=beach polygons tagged access=customers), plus every private concession on the Ksamil strand

Wikidata P31: 19 island rows, 17 viewpoint rows, 25 park or area rows and most of the 72 'other' rows. No regex distinguishes San Marino's Guaita (a sub-summit AND a tower, P31 Q8502) from Monte Titano
elevation_m: 91 not_notable rows. The field is null on 100% of the 5,472 shipped rows and on 100% of the 3,295 mountains, so no elevation floor can be applied anywhere in Europe today
a second dedupe pass: 65 duplicate rows sit outside 250 m and below 0.60 name overlap, mostly Greek/Latin and Cyrillic/Latin script pairs

_regression_corpus: every rule was tested against the 434 seed entries in data/curation/top_picks_seed.json plus 46 endorsed top picks. Remaining hits are documented per rule and are all on non-delete actions, except three rows that survive only because seeds bypass the filters: Ilha da Barreta (PT), Castle Hill / Gediminas Hill (LT) and Serra do Marao (PT).

park_or_area.note: rank_features.py joins UNESCO by a 10 km radius around the property's CENTROID (UNESCO_KM = 10.0) and build_features.py joins protected areas at PROTECTED_KM = 5.0. That is why two Reykjavik city streets carry natural_monument, why six Salzburg city hills carry national_park, why a 1097 battle site 6.4 km from Plitvice carries unesco, and why the whole Ibiza beach blob carries unesco. Designation is worth 0.20 of a beach score and 0.15 of a mountain score, so a bad polygon join is directly promoting junk.
